name: Planning Data Article 4 direction dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 3,167 Article 4 directions from 101 providers; collector last ran 21 July 2026 and the platform notes some MHCLG-created data pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Dataset-level presence is not enough; exact live direction, area and withdrawn rights must be matched to the parcel.

name: Planning Data Article 4 direction area dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 7,133 Article 4 direction areas from 110 providers; collector and new-data dates reach 22 July 2026.
gate: Use authoritative entity geometry and current direction status before applying a parcel constraint.

name: Planning Data Article 4 direction rule dataset
fact: The dataset currently reports zero Article 4 direction-rule records despite one provider; collector last ran 18 July 2026 and provenance includes MHCLG-created data.
gate: Zero records must not be interpreted as zero withdrawn permitted-development rights.

name: Article 4 direction data specification
fact: Planning Data specifies separate Article 4 direction and area datasets, including geometry, start/end dates and withdrawn permitted-development-right codes.
gate: A data specification is not evidence that a particular direction applies to a parcel.

name: Fernhaven Grouse Road Article 4 area
fact: Horsham authoritative Article 4 area ART4007 has exact polygon geometry and records withdrawn rights 2A;2C;4A;4B;6A.
gate: Exact canonical parcel intersection and current legal status are required.

name: Horsham Article 4 area ART4026
fact: Horsham authoritative Article 4 area ART4026 started 9 August 1991 and includes exact multipolygon geometry.
gate: Current direction document and parcel intersection must be verified.

name: Waltham Forest Article 4 area A4D76
fact: Authoritative area A4D76 started 29 June 2023, has exact geometry and records permitted-development-right code 3MA.
gate: Area membership is a planning-control signal, not automatic refusal or development capacity.

name: Upper Upnor Article 4 area
fact: Medway authoritative Upper Upnor(9) Article 4 area has entry date 19 February 2026 and exact polygon geometry.
gate: Exact parcel intersection and linked live direction are required.

name: Historic Rochester Article 4 area
fact: Medway authoritative Historic Rochester(5) Article 4 area has entry date 19 February 2026 and exact polygon geometry.
gate: Exact parcel intersection and linked live direction are required.

name: Great Yarmouth HMO Article 4 area
fact: Authoritative Great Yarmouth HMO Article 4 area began 24 September 2012 and is linked to direction A4D016.
gate: Current extent and parcel intersection must be verified before applying HMO control.

name: York HMO Article 4 area
fact: York authoritative HMO Article 4 area began 20 April 2012 and records withdrawn right 3L.
gate: Parcel membership does not establish project viability; it changes the permission route.

name: Lambeth Modified Direction 1 CAZ area A4D10A22
fact: Authoritative Lambeth Modified Direction 1 CAZ area A4D10A22 started 28 October 2022 and has exact polygon geometry.
gate: Match parcel to area and linked direction before applying control.

name: Lambeth Modified Direction 1 CAZ area A4D10A52
fact: Authoritative Lambeth Modified Direction 1 CAZ area A4D10A52 started 28 October 2022 and has exact polygon geometry.
gate: Match parcel to area and linked direction before applying control.

name: Southwark Central Activities Zone Article 4 direction
fact: Southwark authoritative direction 115 notes that change of use from offices to dwelling houses is restricted in the Central Activities Zone.
gate: The direction document and exact affected area must be checked; a legal instrument without geometry is not a parcel relation.

name: Westminster Class E to C3 CAZ Article 4 direction
fact: Westminster authoritative direction restricts Class E commercial/business/service use changing to C3 dwellings in specified CAZ areas; start date 22 July 2022.
gate: Exact affected area and current document control are required.

name: Westminster Class E to C3 outside CAZ Article 4 direction
fact: Westminster authoritative direction restricts Class E to C3 change in specified town-centre areas outside the CAZ; start date 5 December 2021.
gate: Exact affected area and current direction document must be matched.

name: Waltham Forest Article 4 direction A4DocRef3
fact: Waltham Forest authoritative direction A4DocRef3 started 24 July 2018 and links to the authority notice/documentation.
gate: Direction metadata alone does not identify an affected parcel without the linked area.

name: Barnet Glenhill Close Article 4 direction
fact: Barnet direction A4D3 began 31 July 2002; the record warns historic permitted-development classes have been translated into modern counterparts and old maps may be superseded.
gate: Read the current authority page/document before relying on translated historic classes or maps.

name: Ashford agricultural and forestry Article 4 direction
fact: Ashford authoritative direction ART29-ART/08/333 started 7 May 2009 and concerns caravan, agricultural and forestry permitted-development controls.
gate: Exact direction area and current document remain required.

name: Odium Wood Bethersden Article 4 direction
fact: Ashford authoritative Odium Wood Bethersden direction started 18 December 1981 and provides current authority document links.
gate: Historic age increases need for live document and area verification.

name: EA Flood Map for Planning Flood Zones
fact: Environment Agency Flood Zones data was updated 6 July 2026 and defines present-day river/sea Flood Zones 2 and 3 while Flood Zone 1 is the remainder.
gate: The dataset is a planning screen and ignores defence benefits; site-specific flood evidence remains required.

name: EA Flood Zones plus Climate Change
fact: Updated 6 July 2026; the EA layer shows how the combined extent of Flood Zones 2 and 3 could increase over the next century with climate change, ignoring defence benefits.
gate: Use to trigger FRA/sequential-test review, not as a property-level deterministic flood result.

name: EA Surface Water Spatial Planning Extents Present Day
fact: Updated 6 July 2026; present-day surface-water extents cover 0.1%, 1% and 3.3% annual-exceedance-probability scenarios.
gate: EA states the dataset is indicative for land and not suitable for determining whether an individual property will flood.

name: EA Surface Water Spatial Planning Extents Climate Change
fact: Updated 6 July 2026; climate-change surface-water extents use UKCP18 RCP8.5 upper-end 2070s allowances for long-term planning.
gate: Indicative strategic screening only; exact parcel and FRA assessment remain required.

name: EA Surface Water Spatial Planning Depths Present Day
fact: EA present-day surface-water depth data provides seven depth bands across 0.1%, 1% and 3.3% AEP scenarios.
gate: Depth bands are modelled planning information and are not an individual-property flood prediction.
